component.name: msol
component.summary: Microsoft 365 web apps as separate windows, with one sign-in

description.p: msol runs Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams and the other Microsoft 365 web apps in windows of their own, each with its own taskbar entry and icon, sharing one dedicated Microsoft Edge profile so you sign in once.
Microsoft Edge is downloaded from Microsoft when you install msol. msol is an independent project, not made, endorsed or supported by Microsoft.
